There will be battles over battles and famines over your time. A leader must have energy to continue to serve their Clan throughout the harshest times and keep their spirits ascended.
With this sixth life, we give you love.
With diversity comes disagreement and even argument, but a leader must learn to love their Clanmates and respect their opinions whether they disagree or not.
With this fourth life, we give you courage.
Wounds and death are horrible things to think of, but sometimes, it cannot be avoided. Use this life to stand up to your fears and die for what you believe is right.
With this fifth life, we give you strength.
Famine and battles could bring death and weakness, but a good leader must understand their Clan's strength in recovery and their own strength in spirit.
With this seventh life, we give you forgiveness.
Only time could change a character, and sometimes it is best to move on from what was done long ago to make way for a better now.
With this final life, we give you curiosity.

It is always a good thing to catch evils early, and a curious mind would allow such a character to discover these things quickly. Allow yourself to investigate to understand what's around you to help yourself and your Clan.
These are the nine lives you will use to defend your Clan and serve them into success when you've passed.

MESSAGE: Let me tell you about my friend Creamfrost.
Creamfrost has been my best friend since I was born.
She was actually an apprentice when I was a kit.
Especially when she met Gemstone, her mate.
They had *three* litters of kits, and I was like a mother to every single one of them whenever Creamfrost wanted some sleep time.
Once Hollypelt grew into a warrior, she took over as the mother, even babying Gemstone.
You see, Gemstone and Liontail were the closest of friends and *loved* to collect rocks.
Gemstone almost always forgot about *everything* whenever Liontail came to him with a new discovery.
They tried to get their kits involved but none of them grew into it.
Creamfrost especially mocked them for their tastes, but she loved them anyway.
You probably don't think much of Sparrowtail.
She's not the sweetest berry in the bush.
But I remember, as an apprentice, before the Severance, she was a little more lighthearted.
Her father Badgerface was this huge, muscular tom with the worst attitude and the most dreadful manners, but somehow, he had a kit named Ravenshade.
Ravenshade, a quiet, sweet black sheep of the family.
The sisters got along so well as apprentices. Sparrowpaw had been so different....
Our first deputy Fisherclaw was the luckiest tom to take Ravenshade as a mate.
Around that time, however, Sparrowtail had gotten distant and bitter.
She had kits, but no one knew about the father, and she was strict on keeping that to herself.
Milkywillow and Stormpaw grew up to be fine cats, but during the Severance, Stormpaw walked away with Firestar, and we never heard from him again.
Sparrowtail found love once again with Webbedfoot, but ever since his recent fox attack that left a scar on his face, she hasn't talked to him.
Nightkit is really lucky to grow up with you and Breezekit.
I just know you two will make her feel special.
If you go by the training grounds and see a gray owl, don't be alarmed.
That's probably Alyssa. Amberclaw wouldn't allow any other owl to get near camp otherwise.
Remember Ravenshade? She actually had an owl friend named Silva.
Back then, the apprentices gave her a really hard time mocking her for talking to birds and even shaking Silva's tree.
They couldn't understand why she liked that owl so much. Silva was a bit of a bully.
Buuut Fisherclaw demanded everyone to leave the owl alone, but you know apprentices.
Silva had laid an egg in that tree, and Ravenshade watched over it every day.
Unfortunately, a bunch of the apprentices went out to hunt and spotted the mother owl picking for food.
Beepaw came back with her kill, and Ravenshade was horribly devastated.
But she kept the baby owl alive once she hatched.
Alyssa grew up with the Clan. She comes and goes at times, but BrambleClan knows she isn't here to hurt them.
And luckily, we have some obedient apprentices this time.
I think I've run out of stories to tell!
Whenever you'd like, I have plenty of stories.
Bramblestar wouldn't want me in there.
You know there's an  hawk up in that tree?
